name: SHUKET
full_name: SearcH for U(1) darK matter with an Electromagnetic Telescope
summary: A dedicated dark-photon search for weak radio-frequency radiation generated at a metal–air interface.
detection_principle: A metal surface converts dark-photon fields into electromagnetic radiation, received by an electromagnetic telescope and analyzed for narrow spectral signals.

status.label: Published experimental record; current overall operating status unverified
status.evidence: 2019 sources support the phase recorded here, rather than a real-time status of the entire project as of the access date.

timeline.event: Direct Searches for Hidden-Photon Dark Matter with the SHUKET Experiment

collaboration.name: SHUKET Collaboration / project team
collaboration.participants_note: Only documented principal institutions are listed; full author and affiliation lists are in the sources. Collaborating-institution addresses are not substituted for detector locations.

results.summary: No significant dark-matter signal; kinetic-mixing upper limits were derived from noise fluctuations.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
